import os, textwrap, importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    """Shift every row down one; fill the vacated top row with the grid background."""
    if not grid:
        return []
    from collections import Counter
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background for _ in grid[0]]] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]
'''
